M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation

This lesson will discuss trends in energy access, transitions, and financing in each of the UNDP’s regional bureaus: Arab States, Latin America and the Caribbean, Africa, Asia and the Pacific, and Europe and the Commonwealth.
Adopting varied approaches and tools to deliver the energy transition
Africa’s energy transition is a transformative opportunity to address energy poverty, unlock green growth, and foster inclusive development.
